newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: INSIGHT - Dutch chartists upbeat again on AEX.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Dutch chartists upbeat again on AEX.

text.p: Dutch chartists remain upbeat on the AEX share index for the coming week, although some of their comments also include an element of caution.
"The market has reached overbought areas while support levels are far away, so close stops are essential," said ABN AMRO, while continuing to recommend long positions.
The Dutch AEX share index jumped to a new record of about 739-points on Monday-afternoon, a rise of over 10 points.
ING Barings sees panic buying. "As the market has suddenly started a sharp rally, current charts suggest a blowoff situation with another strong advance to new highs,"
Contributor Trend Pvs view Support Resistance

ING Barings - Recent strong pick up in momentum shows a large jump in trading activity. As the market has suddenly started a sharp rally, current charts suggest a blowoff situation with another strong advance to new highs. Extremely strong money flow and bullish advance/decline ratio's suggest buying panic. However, as the charts remain remarkably bullish, the risks are growing. Short term 2-week rising trend channel offers support at 710, and shows overhead resistance at 730.

ABN AMRO - In our last comment we wrote: Our medium term target lies around 720. At the moment that level had been reached at the speed of light, therefore we advise to pull-up your exit-stops in order not to let your profits deteriorate. So stick to the long scenario as long as there is no indication of the opposite. The wedge which was taken out two weeks ago confirmed the scenario with prices around 720 in the near future. An extension of that continuation pattern brings us to the next target at the 750 level. However, be careful, the market has reached overbought areas while support levels are far away, so close stops are essential.

IRIS - Even the short-term channel which runs nearly vertical is now being broken upwardly. We do not know where the move will end but we stick with it as long as 722 is not taken out to the downside.
